subject: Request to rotate/deflect demo dates during company holiday & Cloud Summit travel
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Patel <jordan@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Rebecca Li <rebecca@atlashealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Request to rotate demo scheduled Dec 28 — holiday + Cloud Summit travel

Hi Jordan,

First — thank you for the time last week, I appreciated the clarity on Atlas Health's prioritization for patient-search latency. We have your slot booked for Dec 28 at 10:00 AM PT.

Quick heads-up: Redwood has a company-wide reduced-ops window the week of Dec 26–30 (holiday coverage + a number of our SEs are at Cloud Summit). Because of that, the engineer we planned for your session will be traveling and on-call backup is limited. I want to make sure you get the attention the demo deserves, not a shortened run-through.

Would you be open to one of these options?
- Move the live demo to the week of Jan 4–8 (we have full coverage and can run the 60–90m deep-dive with your data).
- Keep Dec 28 but take a pre-recorded run of the exact demo plus a 30m live Q&A (we can record a session tailored to your dataset and then hop on for questions).
- Keep Dec 28 and proceed with a smaller scope (key flows only) if you need to keep the date.

If you prefer Jan, we can propose three slots and lock one down this week. If Dec 28 still works, we’ll send a recording + 30m follow-up invite and confirm a backup SE.

Attachments: atlas-calendar-proposal.ics (proposed Jan slots), redwood-demo-runbook-v2.pdf (runbook + dependencies).

Thanks — want to make this painless for your end.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194

---
P.S. If there are other Atlas stakeholders who should be on the demo invite (SRE or security), add them and I’ll include a short security/infra section in the walkthrough.

From: Jordan Patel <jordan@atlashealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rebecca Li <rebecca@atlashealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to rotate demo scheduled Dec 28 — holiday + Cloud Summit travel

Thanks, Naomi — really appreciate the transparency. Dec 28 is not ideal on our side either (several of our ops folks are OOO), so moving is fine.

We prefer a full live demo in January so the team can be present. The week of Jan 4th looks good. Proposed windows from our side: Jan 5 at 9:00 AM PT, Jan 6 at 11:00 AM PT, or Jan 7 at 2:00 PM PT. Any of those work?

If you can lock one of those and send an updated invite we’ll confirm internally.

Cheers,
Jordan
Senior Product Manager, Atlas Health
jordan@atlashealth.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Atlas Health — need to rotate presenter + confirm Jan slots (DH-7842)

Team — Jordan at Atlas confirmed Jan week preferences (Jan 5 / Jan 6 / Jan 7). Can one of you take the live demo? Details below and two asks: 1) who will present; 2) which of the three slots you prefer so I can lock the calendar.

Context: original slot was Dec 28; Redwood-wide reduced ops that week and several SEs (including our original) will be at Cloud Summit. Jordan asked for a full live session in Jan. We should aim for a 75–90 minute technical demo that includes:
- Data ingestion (S3 + streaming sample)
- Latency profiling using our tracing hooks
- Cost/perf tradeoffs (quantization + batching settings)
- Ops/rollout discussion (dedicated vs hosted)

Proposed presenter rotation:
- Dylan: Jan 5 at 9:00 AM PT — deep model/serving internals + latency profiling
- Hannah: Jan 6 at 11:00 AM PT — integration, onboarding, and infra/security questions
- Naomi: Jan 7 at 2:00 PM PT — overview + commercial/next steps (happy to run if needed)

If Dylan or Hannah can confirm within a day I’ll pick a slot and send the invite with the runbook attached. If neither are available we should push to Jan 11+.

Thanks,
Naomi

> Attachment: redwood-demo-runbook-v2.pdf (full agenda + checklist)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Atlas Health — need to rotate presenter + confirm Jan slots (DH-7842)

Naomi — I can take Jan 5 at 9:00 AM PT. I’ll lead the demo and cover the serving internals and latency profiling. I’ve pulled the latest demo container and will run a quick dry-run with the runbook tomorrow.

Hannah — can you be on the invite as backup for the infra/security section? If you’re available on Jan 5 I’ll push a short handoff doc to the drive.

I attached a short handoff note and the dry-run checklist. I’ll also add a paragraph to the invite about expected attendee roles so Atlas knows which stakeholders to bring.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
